Yahan kuch zabardast aur useful plugins ke ideas hain jo aapke WhatsApp bot (ABIX) mein add kiye ja sakte hain:

### 1. Smart Notes & Reminders Plugin (`reminder.js`)
* **Kaam kya karega:** Users bot ko bol kar personal reminders set kar sakte hain (e.g., `-reminder 10m Chai peene ka waqt ho gaya` ya `-note Meeting points...`). Bot tayyar waqt par unhe WhatsApp par personal message ya group mein tag karke notify kar dega.

### 2. Quick Poll / Voting Plugin (`poll.js`)
* **Kaam kya karega:** Groups ke andar aasaani se voting ya surveys karane ke liye. 
* **Command:** `-poll "Aaj kahan chalna hai?" "Cafe" "Park" "Movie"`

### 3. Inline AI Image Generator / Vision Plugin (`imagegen.js`)
* **Kaam kya karega:** Agar bot ke paas AI API integration hai, toh user koi prompt de kar directly WhatsApp par AI images generate karwa sakega.
* **Command:** `-img A futuristic cyberpunk city at night`

### 4. Group Welcome & Good-bye Plugin (`welcome.js`)
* **Kaam kya karega:** Jaise hi koi naya member group mein join kare, bot ek pyara sa customizable welcome message bhej de (with custom rules/tags), aur leave karne par goodbye message de.

### 5. Quick QR Code Generator (`qr.js`)
* **Kaam kya karega:** Kisi bhi text ya URL ka instant QR code bana kar image ki shakal mein group ya chat mein bhej dega.
* **Command:** `-qr [https://example.com](https://example.com)`

Aapke project mein ya general `ruhend-scraper` package ke andar jo functions available hote hain, unka kaam usually social media platforms (jaise Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube) se media extract karna hota hai. 

Kyunki `ruhend-scraper` ek third-party npm package hai, iske andar commonly yeh functions ya methods milte hain:

* **`igdl(url)`**: Instagram video/photo download karne ke liye.
* **`tikdl(url)`**: TikTok videos bina watermark ke download karne ke liye.
* **`fbdl(url)`**: Facebook videos download karne ke liye.
* **`ytdl(url)`** ya **`youtube(url)`**: YouTube videos ya audio ke liye.
* **`twitterdl(url)`**: Twitter/X media download karne ke liye.

Agar aapko apne project mein dekhna hai ki `ruhend-scraper` kahan-kahan import ho raha hai ya uske kaunse specific methods aapke bot ki files use kar rahe hain, toh aap `plugins/` folder ke andar `igdl` ya `instagram` wali file check kar sakte hain.
